# Raw Workflow — focused end-to-end raw file operations

# === INIT ===
exec akb init raw-kb
cd raw-kb

# === RAW WRITE ===
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/data.csv'

# === RAW STATUS (NO DRIFT) ===
exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# === MODIFY FILE EXTERNALLY ===
cp ../modified-input.txt raw/data.csv

# === RAW STATUS (DRIFT DETECTED) ===
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'MODIFIED data.csv'

# === RAW SYNC (FIX DRIFT) ===
exec akb raw sync
stdout 'Synced'

# === RAW STATUS (CLEAN AGAIN) ===
exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# === RAW DELETE ===
exec akb raw delete data.csv
stdout 'Deleted raw/data.csv'
! exists raw/data.csv

# === RAW LIST EMPTY ===
exec akb raw list
! stdout .

-- csv-input.txt --
hello,world

-- modified-input.txt --
modified content
